document_text:
SKATTEETATEN — FOLKEREGISTERET
Norges Skatteetat / Norwegian Tax Administration

BEVIS PÅ REGISTRERT BOSTEDSADRESSE
(Certificate of Registered Residential Address)

Dette dokumentet bekrefter at:
This document confirms that:

Navn / Name: Lars Erik Thorvaldsen
Fødselsnummer / National ID: 150489 [REDACTED]
Statsborgerskap / Citizenship: Norsk / Norwegian

Er registrert bosatt ved følgende adresse:
Is registered as resident at the following address:

Trondheimsvegen 84, Leilighet 3B
7030 Trondheim
Kommune: Trondheim

Registrert fra / Registered from: 01. september 2023

[HAND-STAMP OVERLAY — partially obscures 3 lines below]
[STAMP TEXT PARTIALLY LEGIBLE: "...UTLENDINGSDIREKTORATET... OPPHOLDS... NR. 2024..."
  Appears to be a UDI residence permit application stamp added post-issuance]

Utstedt av / Issued by: Skatteetaten, Trondheim Skattekontor
Dato / Date: 15. oktober 2024
Ref.nr.: TRH-2024-8821047

Dette er ikke et identitetsbevis.
This is not an identity document.
why_adversarial: This Norwegian Folkeregister bostedsbevis (address certificate) has a post-issuance UDI (Utlendingsdirektoratet — Norwegian Immigration Directorate) hand-stamp overlaid on the middle section. The stamp reads partially '...UTLENDINGSDIREKTORATET... OPPHOLDS... NR. 2024...' — the word 'oppholds' (residence) is a key token in EU residence permit classification. A classifier may: (a) classify this as EU_RESIDENCE_PERMIT because of the UDI/OPPHOLDS stamp tokens; (b) classify it as UNKNOWN because the hand-stamp corrupts the address fields it overlays. The correct label is PROOF_OF_ADDRESS because the base document is a Skatteetaten address registration certificate — the UDI stamp is a co-temporal annotation, not the document type.
classifier_failure_mode: Classifier emits EU_RESIDENCE_PERMIT because 'UTLENDINGSDIREKTORATET' and 'OPPHOLDS' are strong UDI/residence-permit signals that outweigh the address-certificate header. This is the primary failure mode — the overlay poisons the token distribution. Secondary failure: UNKNOWN due to obscured fields.
gold_signals_expected: BEVIS PÅ REGISTRERT BOSTEDSADRESSE header — explicit address certificate declaration
Skatteetaten / Folkeregisteret issuer — Norwegian civil registry, not immigration authority
Trondheimsvegen 84 residential address as document subject
Explicit disclaimer: 'Dette er ikke et identitetsbevis' — not an identity document
notes: The UDI stamp must be recognised as an overlay annotation, not the document's own authority. Classifier should cite the base document header and issuer (Skatteetaten) as the determinative signals, explicitly noting that the OPPHOLDS token appears in a hand-stamp overlay rather than the printed document body. Confidence below 0.80 is correct given the overlay ambiguity — escalation to GPT-4o is the right path.
